The person asks:
Until when can I say no to the bank's new account fee?

response.text:
The bank asks for your answer by Mon 30 Nov 2026 [item:itm_9qzfwbhh5m74]. Its letter is dated Fri 18 Sep 2026 [doc:doc_0b2t88kqsf2n].

- Musterbank eG wants to raise the fee for your Girokonto Klassik. Silence does not count as consent, so the bank needs your explicit agreement.
- If you don't consent, the bank says it reserves the right to terminate the account with two months' notice. So refusing carries some risk.
- To answer, use online banking (Postfach › Zustimmungen) or the signed reply form. If you post the form, the send-by date is Tue 24 Nov 2026 [item:itm_9qzfwbhh5m74].
- The letter says you can close the account yourself free of charge at any time. It also mentions a free "Start" account for people in education up to age 27, which you could ask about.

This is not legal advice. If you're unsure, check with the bank or get advice.
